image_description: A street scene featuring a traditional May Day celebration. A tall green pole (maypole) stands in the center, adorned with a floral wreath at the top and colorful ribbons (red, yellow, blue, green) extending downwards. Dancers in traditional Morris dancing attire (white shirts, black vests with bells, handkerchiefs) are holding the ribbons and weaving around the pole. The background consists of brick buildings with shop fronts, including one labeled 'BOOKS'. Bunting flags hang across the street above.

artifact_observations.location: Top of the maypole / Ribbon attachment points
artifact_observations.reasoning: The ribbons appear to emerge from the floral wreath in a physically ambiguous manner. Some ribbons seem to float slightly above the wreath or merge into the flowers without a clear mechanical anchor point. The geometry of the wreath itself is somewhat soft and indistinct.
The text on the shop sign is legible but exhibits slight warping and uneven letter spacing typical of AI generation, lacking the crisp edge definition of real photography.
In several instances, the boundary between the dancers' hands and the ribbons they are holding is blurred or fused, making it difficult to distinguish where the hand ends and the ribbon begins.

To audit the anatomical correctness of the humans (limbs, fingers) interacting with the ribbons, as hand-ribbon fusion is a common AI artifact.
To verify the physical connectivity of the ribbons to the pole/wreath and ensure no floating or disconnected segments exist.
To rigorously check the legibility and structural integrity of the text in the background, which showed minor warping.
To ensure the pole and dancers are correctly separated from the background buildings and that the perspective of the street is consistent.
